title: On the plasticity of the unit spheres of $\ell_1$, $\ell_{\infty}$, $c$, and Hilbert spaces
summary: This paper demonstrates the expand-contract plasticity of the unit spheres of $\ell_1$, $\ell_{\infty}$, and $c$. Furthermore, it establishes the strong plasticity of the unit spheres of Hilbert spaces.
